Content inside <template> is never rendered per the HTML spec and must not appear in the output

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><template><p>secret template text</p></template><p>also visible</p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
